name: Route Walker X
description: A street-tech hiking trainer built for long routes. Waterproof ripstop upper, padded collar, and a deep lugged outsole that grips mud, rock, and wet city sidewalks.

name: League Classic 90
description: A court-to-street trainer with overlay panels, a chunky midsole, and everyday cushioning. Built for gym battles, long walks between towns, and looking sharp on the route.

name: Petal Classic 90
description: A women's cut of the League Classic 90 with a slimmer collar and softer overlays. Everyday cushioning for gym days, town errands, and long walks between routes.

name: Meadow Runner Lite
description: Tuned for a women's fit. Street-tech hiking trainer built for long routes. Waterproof ripstop upper, padded collar, and a deep lugged outsole that grips mud, rock, and wet city sidewalks. Light colorways made for spring routes, park paths, and weekend travel.

name: Route Shell Jacket
description: A lightweight men's adventure jacket for wet routes and windy ridges. Packs small, sheds drizzle, and layers over a tee without extra bulk.

name: Route Trail Pant
description: The matching men's pant for the Route Shell Jacket. Stretch woven fabric, zip pockets, and a tapered fit that works on the trail or in town.

name: Meadow Shell Jacket
description: A lightweight women's adventure jacket with a slightly slimmer cut. Wind-resistant, packable, and built to pair with the Meadow Trail Pant.

name: Meadow Trail Pant
description: The women's counterpart to the Meadow Shell Jacket. Stretch trail pant with a high waist, zip pockets, and easy movement for long walks.

name: Route Crew Socks
description: Cushioned men's crew socks for long days in trainers. Arch support, breathable knit, and a stay-up cuff.

name: Petal Ankle Socks
description: Low women's ankle socks with light cushioning. Made to sit clean under the Classic 90 and Meadow Court sneakers.

name: Badge Trail Tee
description: A lightweight men's short-sleeve trail shirt. Soft jersey, easy drape, and quick dry for warm routes.

name: Bloom Trail Tee
description: A women's trail tee with a relaxed cropped-hem option in the cut. Breathable jersey for hikes, errands, and travel days.

name: Summit Badge Cap
description: A structured men's cap for sun and rain on the route. Sweatband inside, adjustable strap in back.

name: Meadow Soft Cap
description: A softer women's cap with a slightly curved brim. Light colors for spring routes and travel days.

name: Ridge Grip Gloves
description: Light men's gloves for cool mornings and rocky climbs. Touchscreen fingertips and a snug cuff.

name: Bloom Grip Gloves
description: Women's light adventure gloves with a slimmer hand pattern. Warm enough for dawn routes, thin enough for pack straps.

name: Ember Steel Bottle
description: Double-wall steel bottle that keeps water cold on long routes. Leak-resistant cap and a grip loop for pack straps.

name: Dewdrop Trail Flask
description: A lighter plastic flask for short hikes and gym days. Squeeze-friendly, wide mouth, easy to toss in a satchel.

name: Summit Haul Pack
description: Large expedition backpack for multi-day routes. Padded hip belt, sleeping-bag sleeve, and room for a tent and cook kit.

name: Route Daypack
description: Medium everyday pack for class, travel, and day hikes. Laptop sleeve, bottle pocket, and a clean street-tech look.

name: Badge Mini Pack
description: Small pack for short errands and light trail runs. Just enough room for a bottle, jacket, and snacks.

name: Field Satchel
description: A sturdy crossbody satchel for maps, snacks, and a flask. Adjustable strap and a quick-grab front pocket.

name: Meadow Satchel
description: A lighter satchel with a softer shape. Built for town days and easy travel, with room for a bottle and a light jacket.

name: Ember Down Bag
description: Cold-route mummy bag rated for near-freezing nights. Compresses into a stuff sack that clips to the Summit Haul Pack.

name: Trail Quilt Bag
description: Midweight sleeping bag for three-season camps. More room to move than a mummy bag, still warm on cool nights.

name: Meadow Light Bag
description: A compact warm-weather bag for summer routes and indoor camps. Packs small and pairs with the Meadow tents.

name: Ridge Solo Tent
description: One-person tent with a small footprint and quick setup. Rainfly included for sudden route storms.

name: Meadow Partner Tent
description: Two-person tent with extra vestibule space for packs and boots. Stable in wind, light enough for a shared haul.

name: Ember Trail Cook Kit
description: Small camping cook set: nesting pot, lid-pan, fold handle, and two sporks. Fits in the side pocket of a daypack.
